note: The read takes no selector. Unknown top-level member is rejected.
`snapshot` is required — the read always answers with a snapshot, never an acknowledgement alone.
`counters`, `gauges` and `histograms` are always present, even when the VTA exposes none of a kind — omitting one does not mean "none", it means the field was dropped.
A counter's `value` must be a number, not a string.
